hypotheses.name: QUESTION_ONLY_MEASUREMENT_ROLE_CLOSURE
success_conditions: role_closure macro Recall@5R - flat_rrf macro Recall@5R >= 0.025
role_closure every-component question rate - flat_rrf rate >= 0.10 and count gain >= 4
role_closure macro complete-component rate - flat_rrf rate >= 0.025
role_closure macro Recall@5R >= direct_bm25 macro Recall@5R
kill_conditions: any success condition is not met
generation reads source papers, explanations, provenance, target identifiers, or evidence before all predictions are written
flat_rrf and role_closure do not share exactly the same component queries and per-query rankings
hypotheses.scope: Recorded local OADD-Bench pilot on 32 hash-selected questions using qwen2.5:7b and offline HRS metadata only

outcome.reason: the carrier was valid, but hierarchical role-component round robin did not improve every-component coverage and reduced both exact-column recall and complete-component rate relative to the shared-query flat RRF baseline
